**Risk flags:**  
- No major flags  

**Overview:**  
Mega Murni Klinik Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company providing home nursing care for the elderly, incorporated on 6 December 1996 and based in Selangor. The firm has a share capital of RM 500,000, five directors, and its largest shareholder holds 37.75 % of the equity. Financially, the company reported revenue of RM 9,091,071 in 2022, RM 12,205,036 in 2023, and RM 16,938,873 in 2024, with unqualified audit opinions each year. Net margins were 6.74 % (2022), 6.79 % (2023) and 9.64 % (2024), and current ratios ranged from 1.81 to 2.15.
